decisions.title: Trash & Recycling

facts.text: Trash is collected every week: Monday in Providence, Tuesday in Ascent, and Thursday in Prospect and Parkvale. Recycling is picked up every other week on the same community day.
facts.value: Trash is collected every week: Monday in Providence, Tuesday in Ascent, and Thursday in Prospect and Parkvale. Recycling is picked up every other week on the same community day.
facts.context: Trash is collected every week: Monday in Providence, Tuesday in Ascent, and Thursday in Prospect and Parkvale. Recycling is picked up every other week on the same community day.
facts.supportingQuote: For Providence, trash is picked up weekly on Monday, and recycling is picked up every other Monday. For Ascent, trash is picked up weekly on Tuesday, and recycling is picked up every other Tuesday. For Prospect and Parkvale, trash is picked up weekly on Thursday, and recycling is picked up every other Thursday.

facts.text: Put bins out by 7 a.m. and return them to a screened location by the end of pickup day.
facts.value: Put bins out by 7 a.m. and return them to a screened location by the end of pickup day.
facts.context: Put bins out by 7 a.m. and return them to a screened location by the end of pickup day.
facts.supportingQuote: Make sure to place bins outside by 7 am for trash collection. Containers for pickup may be placed on the street or alleyway on the morning of pickup and must be returned to an appropriately screened location by the end of the pickup day.

facts.text: New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas move pickup back by one day.
facts.value: New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas move pickup back by one day.
facts.context: New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas move pickup back by one day.
facts.supportingQuote: Trash pickup will be delayed by one day for the following holidays: New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas.
